case_title: Birendra Das & Anr. v. State of Assam
aggravating_circumstances: Use of deadly weapons, brutal nature of the crime, dragging the body and severing limbs
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under s.302/34 IPC, sentenced to life imprisonment
neutral_facts: The prosecution alleges that nine individuals hacked a 40-year-old man with deadly weapons, causing his death. The deceased was attacked in the morning, and the accused, armed with weapons, assaulted him, leading to severe injuries and his eventual death. The accused then dragged the body to a courtyard and continued to attack it, severing limbs. An eyewitness reported the incident, and the deceased's son and a relative testified about the attack. Medical evidence confirmed the nature of the injuries, and the body was found in the courtyard of one of the accused. The investigation included the recovery of weapons and the examination of the deceased's injuries. The trial court convicted two of the accused under s.302 IPC in aid of s.34 IPC, and the High Court affirmed the conviction and sentence.
